text:
sqlpipe is a command-line tool for syncing Postgres tables to S3 as Parquet files. Point it at a database, choose the tables (or queries) you care about, and it streams rows into columnar Parquet objects in your bucket—ready for analytics engines, data lakes, or downstream pipelines.

It handles incremental and full exports, preserves schema where it matters, and keeps the workflow simple: configure a source and destination, run the sync, and get durable, query-friendly files on S3 without standing up a separate ETL stack. Whether you are backing up operational data, feeding a warehouse, or sharing snapshots across teams, sqlpipe turns Postgres into portable Parquet with a single CLI.
